fixed.summary: A node's plate, icon and caption keep their text size only up to a share of the well's own width and height, so on a narrow well (a phone's, where the whole graph is scaled down to fit across it) a node's caption no longer lands on the node in the row below. Desktop graphs, and graphs with room to spare, are unchanged. The nodes and captions still grow with the text size where the well has room for them.

breaking.change: A node's plate, icon and caption no longer take their size straight from --size-lg, --size-sm and --hud-tag-size. They read --graph-node, --graph-icon and --graph-caption, which default to those sizes capped to a share of the well.
breaking.fix: A container that sized NodeGraph's nodes by setting --size-lg, --size-sm or --hud-tag-size on it (as CardRunMap did) sets --graph-node, --graph-icon and --graph-caption instead.
